title: Seaview Palms Oasis - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
SEAVIEW PALMS OASIS Highlights:

⭐ Professionally managed with 24/7 guest support by 30A Five Star Properties 🏖️ Private beach access for Palms owners and guests ⛱️ Seasonal beach chair service included (2 chairs + umbrella | March 1–Oct 31) 🪑 Extra backpack chairs, umbrellas & beach towels provided ✨ Updated interior with professional décor 👑 King bed 🛏️ Bunk beds 👶 Pack ’n Play (perfect for little ones) 🛁 2 full bathrooms 🧺 Washer and dryer inside the condo 🌤️ Corner balconies for relaxing views 👣 1 mile to Seaside 🏊‍♀️ Community pool 🍳 Fully stocked kitchen with drip coffee maker and Keurig 🚲 Community bike racks for personal or rented bikes 🛍️ Walking distance to shopping and dining 🌿 Spacious green areas throughout the community 🚴‍♀️ Access to the scenic 22-mile Timpoochee Trail

Welcome to Seaview Palms Oasis, your modern coastal getaway just moments from the turquoise waves and sugar-white sands of 30A. This stylish condo blends comfort and convenience, offering a relaxing king bedroom, cozy bunk beds, and bright living spaces perfect for families or groups.

Guests love the easy access to Seagrove Beach, walkability to Seaside, and the peaceful, gated community amenities. Spend your days biking along scenic trails, exploring local shops and restaurants, or unwinding by the pool after a beach-filled morning.

Seagrove is a longtime favorite in South Walton, offering a laid-back coastal atmosphere with plenty to explore. Don’t miss a local classic like Café 30A or a sunset bike ride to Seaside and WaterColor.

We’re so excited to welcome you to Seaview Palms Oasis. Your beach escape awaits!

Condo is on the 3rd floor. No elevator on site.

Sorry, HOA does not allow pets.

Check-In: A keypad is available 24 hours a day to provide entry for guests
